Santé Express

Making a health service easy to understand and easy to choose.

Client

Year

Graphic design · Social media content · Page management

Project

A clear visual presence for a health service that needs to reassure before it convinces. I applied the Santé Express identity across posts, flyers and educational visuals designed to explain the service, answer doubts and make people want to order.

The work also covered page management: planning, captions, message replies and tracking which visuals held attention best.
